notes: Recorded 23 bachelor's and 79 master's programme rows where the institution's own page names them: Twente 29 (master), Maastricht 36 (master), Fontys 4+4, HZ 8 (bachelor), Rotterdam UAS 11+5, HKU 3 (master), PThU 1, Driestar 1. The official scheme page lists 33 participating institutions for 2027-2028 (10 research universities, 23 universities of applied sciences); the rest give no programme names (see not_stated).

Intake years differ by page and are given in each row's detail: Twente and Maastricht are 2027/28; HZ is deadline 1 May 2027; HKU and Rotterdam UAS are 2026/27 (deadline 1 May 2026); Fontys states no year.

Rules without a list: Radboud - all English-taught Master's programmes except Erasmus Mundus and joint-degree programmes (32 awards for 2027-2028 spread over six faculties); Groningen - 'Programmes: All' (levels Master and Bachelor, applicants must have an admission offer for a programme in its programme list); Saxion - all bachelor programmes; Utrecht University - international Master's programmes but 'Not all programmes participate' (check each programme page); VU Amsterdam - full-time English-taught Master's; Wageningen - eligible on-campus MSc programmes, not online or double-degree; Amsterdam UAS - full-time English-taught bachelor's or master's (Global Sustainable Business Management master's students cannot apply); Amsterdam University of the Arts - English-taught bachelor's or master's; HU Utrecht - English-taught bachelor programmes; HAN - full-time English-taught degrees; Breda UAS - bachelor's; Theological University Utrecht - theology only ('If you wish to study in any other field than theology, you cannot apply for this scholarship through our university'); Design Academy Eindhoven - Master level only (5 awards, 2026 starters).

Hanze UAS: its page lists master's programmes under the 'Hanze Scholarship' heading; the page text read could not show which of them are the NL Scholarship, so none were recorded. The Eindhoven University of Technology page found is for outgoing exchange students, so none were recorded.
Hotelschool The Hague's page still described the 2024-2025 scholarship (bachelor's), so it is not used.
not_stated: Programme names for Radboud, Groningen, Utrecht, VU Amsterdam, Wageningen, Aeres, Amsterdam UAS, Amsterdam University of the Arts, ArtEZ, Breda, Codarts, Design Academy Eindhoven, Gerrit Rietveld Academie, The Hague UAS, HAN, Hanze, Hotelschool The Hague, HU Utrecht, NHL Stenden, Saxion (masters), Thomas More, University of the Arts The Hague, Theological University Utrecht, Zuyd, Eindhoven University of Technology (incoming)
Whether any single field is open across all institutions (the scheme page says each institution lists its own fields)
fetch_problems: NHL Stenden scholarship page returned HTTP 403 (not read).
Zuyd's scholarship page redirects to the general home page and Thomas More's page has no NL Scholarship content, so neither was read for a programme list.
Maastricht: only the official PDF list of participating Master's programmes was used, not the individual programme pages.
